issue_request: FHIR-7848 is a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for the DSTU1 MedicationStatement v2 mapping page. It asked to blank the quantity mapping to RXA-6 Administered Amount and RXA-7 Administered Units because MedicationStatement is not MedicationAdministration and RXA administration mappings were not appropriate there.
initial_application: The Jira records an 8-0-0 vote and a QA-applied comment. SVN-era commit 5bb461af1063efe577bac2b8b17b6992be7560bf explicitly included tracker #7848 and removed the exact RXA-6/RXA-7 quantity v2 mapping from the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet source.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative StructureDefinition declares the HL7 v2 mapping identity but only maps MedicationStatement.subject to PID-3 Patient ID List; no RXA, Administered Amount, or Administered Units text remains under source/medicationstatement. Sibling MedicationStatement RXA/RAS cleanup trackers exist, and FHIR-7849 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active source already satisfies the requested removal and adding or deleting current text would not improve implementer understanding.
